context: 18 testcases. Four carry only a retry element and no final result - reservesStock and notifiesWarehouse (flakyFailure), settlesNightly (flakyFailure) and retriesOn3dsChallenge (flakyError) - meaning they failed an attempt and then passed. Two carry retry elements AND a final result - recalculatesTax (two rerunFailure plus a final failure) and reconcilesLedger (rerunError plus a final error) - meaning they failed every attempt. Two failed once with no retry recorded (exportsToLedger, formatsReceipt) and one is skipped. Predicted baseline failure: the agent treats the presence of any retry element as the flake signal and reports 6 flaky tests, which is how recalculatesTax - the tax rounding bug the team already lost to a mute - keeps reaching the quarantine list. The opposite predicted failure is deriving the rate from the final results only, which is what the current PR summary does: the run ends with 4 red tests and the 4 that needed a retry are invisible because they finished green. A third is handling flakyFailure but not flakyError / rerunError, which silently loses retriesOn3dsChallenge and misclassifies reconcilesLedger.

checklist.name: Script, tests, and report delivered
checklist.description: scripts/flake-report.js runs and writes flake-report.json, test/flake-report.test.js exists, flake-report.md exists, and npm test passes with the pre-existing test/xml.test.js still passing.

checklist.name: Flaky means passed on a retry: exactly 4
checklist.description: Exactly 4 tests are classified flaky - reservesStock, notifiesWarehouse, settlesNightly, retriesOn3dsChallenge. Reporting 6 by counting every test with a retry element scores zero. Including recalculatesTax or reconcilesLedger in the flaky set scores zero, since both failed on every attempt and muting them is the failure the task opens with.

checklist.name: Consistent failures and unretried failures kept apart
checklist.description: 2 tests failed every attempt (recalculatesTax, reconcilesLedger) and 2 failed with no retry recorded (exportsToLedger, formatsReceipt), reported as distinct groups from each other and from the flaky set. Collapsing all 4 into one 'failed' bucket scores at most half; putting any of them in the quarantine list scores zero.

checklist.name: Retry evidence not dropped from the summary
checklist.description: MUST NOT omit the passed-on-retry tests from the reported output on the grounds that they ended green. All 4 are named in flake-report.json and flake-report.md. A report that only lists the run's red tests scores zero on this criterion - that is the existing PR summary the team is complaining about.

checklist.name: Rate published with its denominator
checklist.description: The rate uses the 4 flaky tests as the numerator and states its denominator explicitly: 4/17 = 23.5% of executed tests, or 4/18 = 22.2% of all testcases, either acceptable when the denominator is named. A rate with no stated denominator scores at most half. Using failures, or every test with a retry element, as the numerator scores zero.

checklist.name: Error-flavoured retry elements handled
checklist.description: flakyError is treated like flakyFailure and rerunError like rerunFailure, so retriesOn3dsChallenge is flaky and reconcilesLedger is a consistent failure. Handling only the failure-named elements - which yields 3 flaky and drops reconcilesLedger's retry history - scores zero here.

checklist.name: Executable test covers both retry shapes
checklist.description: test/flake-report.test.js asserts that a testcase with a retry element and no final result is flaky while one with a retry element plus a final failure is not, and passes. Only one of the two cases covered scores at most half; no runnable test scores zero.

checklist.name: Quarantine rule stated
checklist.description: flake-report.md states which category is eligible for quarantine and why the others are not, rather than only listing this run's numbers.
